description: Arduino for VS Code (unofficial): verify, upload, serial port, boards, project libraries, serial monitor, Arduino docs and C++ IntelliSense.
cmd.openReference: Open the Arduino documentation for the word under the cursor
cfg.port: Default serial port, e.g. COM3 or /dev/ttyACM0. The port chosen from the menu is remembered on this computer only.
cfg.sketch: Main sketch folder, relative to the project. Empty = automatic.
cfg.libraryPaths: Folders containing libraries, relative to the project, e.g. `["./lib", "./../commonLibs"]`. `~`, `${workspaceFolder}` and `${env:NAME}` are supported. With several folders, you are asked where to install.
cfg.useGlobalLibraries: Also use the global Arduino IDE libraries (Documents/Arduino/libraries).
cfg.programmer: External programmer, e.g. usbasp. Empty = serial bootloader.
cfg.exportDir: Folder that receives the `.elf` and `.hex` files of **Build binaries**. Relative to the opened folder. Empty = `build/<board>` inside the sketch.
cfg.editorButtons: Also show the Arducode buttons at the top of the editor.
cfg.configureProject: Let Arducode edit the project’s .vscode/settings.json (C/C++ IntelliSense provider, hidden PC run/debug buttons, colors). Empty = ask.
cfg.themeColors: Add C++ colors to the project when the theme is “Visual Studio Dark/Light”, which lack them.
docs.short: Summary, syntax, parameters and return value
